ideas.title: Evening online tutoring for school subjects
ideas.one_liner: Parents pay per session for one-on-one evening tutoring in maths, English or coding basics over video call.
steps: Pick the one subject you know cold
Prepare 5 lesson worksheets
Offer one free trial lesson in parent groups
Offer $25 per 45-minute session for the first month
Set fixed weekday evening slots
Send a 3-line progress note after each session
Ask parents for term-time rebooking
first_customers: Google Maps 4-star shops with unanswered reviews
pitfalls: Get a parent contact for minors
Never tutor beyond your curriculum comfort
Keep sessions under 45 minutes for focus
